<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SPACEMONEY — Видеохостинг</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #060c1a;
    --bg2: #080f20;
    --bg3: #0c1628;
    --card: #0d1730;
    --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    --accent: #2563eb;
    --accent2: #1d4ed8;
    --accent3: #3b82f6;
    --text: #e8eef8;
    --muted: #5a6a88;
    --glow: rgba(37,99,235,0.4);
  }
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
  body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; overflow-x:hidden; }
  body::before {
    content:"";
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    pointer-events:none; z-index:1000; opacity:0.3;
  }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bg3);border-radius:3px}

  /* PAGE SYSTEM */
  .page { display:none; animation:fadeIn 0.35s ease; }
  .page.active { display:block; }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }

  /* NAV */
  nav {
    position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:500;
    padding:0 48px; height:68px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    background:rgba(6,12,26,0.85); backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .logo {
    font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:1.3rem;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer;
  }
  .logo img { width:34px; height:34px; object-fit:contain; image-rendering:pixelated; }
  .logo-dot { width:7px; height:7px; background:var(--accent3); border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent3); animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:0.5;transform:scale(1.3)}}
  .nav-links { display:flex; gap:28px; list-style:none; }
  .nav-links a {
    color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; font-size:0.875rem;
    font-weight:400; transition:color 0.2s; letter-spacing:0.01em; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active { color:var(--text); }
  .nav-links a.active { color:var(--accent3); }
  .nav-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; }
  .btn {
    padding:9px 20px; border-radius:8px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500;
    cursor:pointer; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; transition:all 0.2s;
    border:none; text-decoration:none; display:inline-block;
  }
  .btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:var(--muted); border:1px solid var(--border); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { color:var(--text); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
  .btn-primary { background:var(--accent); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.3); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background:#3b82f6; box-shadow:0 0 32px rgba(37,99,235,0.5); transform:translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-large { padding:13px 30px; font-size:1rem; border-radius:12px; }
  .btn-outline { background:transparent; color:var(--text); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color:var(--accent3); color:var(--accent3); }

  /* CONTAINERS */
  .container { max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; }
  section { padding:72px 48px; }
  .section-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:36px; }
  .section-title { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.8rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.03em; }
  .section-title span { color:var(--accent3); }
  .view-all { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.875rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom:2px; transition:color 0.2s,border-color 0.2s; cursor:pointer; }
  .view-all:hover { color:var(--text); border-color:var(--muted); }

  /* HERO */
  .hero { padding:140px 48px 80px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; min-height:88vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; }
  .hero-bg {
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 600px at 15% 50%, rgba(37,99,235,0.13) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 500px 400px at 85% 30%, rgba(59,130,246,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 400px 300px at 60% 85%, rgba(29,78,216,0.07) 0%, transparent 60%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  /* Stars */
  .stars { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; }
  .star { position:absolute; width:2px; height:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.5); border-radius:50%; animation:twinkle var(--d,3s) ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0.2}50%{opacity:1}}
  .hero-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:64px; align-items:center; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; width:100%; }
  .hero-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:rgba(37,99,235,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.3); border-radius:100px; padding:6px 14px 6px 8px; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--accent3); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.04em; margin-bottom:24px; width:fit-content; }
  .badge-dot { width:6px; height:6px; background:var(--accent3); border-radius:50%; animation:pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .hero h1 { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.5vw,5.2rem); font-weight:800; line-height:1.0; letter-spacing:-0.04em; margin-bottom:24px; }
  .hero h1 em { font-style:normal; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent3) 0%,#93c5fd 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; }
  .hero p { color:var(--muted); font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.7; max-width:460px; margin-bottom:40px; font-weight:300; }
  .hero-cta { display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .play-text { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.875rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:color 0.2s; }
  .play-text:hover { color:var(--text); }
  .play-icon { width:38px; height:38px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.7rem; }
  .tags-row { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:32px; }
  .tag { background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:100px; padding:6px 16px; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; }
  .tag:hover,.tag.active { background:rgba(37,99,235,0.12); border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.35); color:var(--accent3); }

  /* Preview */
  .hero-preview { position:relative; }
  .preview-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; box-shadow:0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
  .preview-thumb { width:100%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060c1a 0%,#0d1f4a 40%,#1a3a7a 100%); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .preview-thumb::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,rgba(37,99,235,0.3),transparent 70%); }
  .big-play { width:70px; height:70px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(10px); position:relative; z-index:2; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s; }
  .big-play:hover { background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); transform:scale(1.08); box-shadow:0 0 40px var(--glow); }
  .big-play svg { width:26px; height:26px; fill:white; margin-left:4px; }
  .preview-bars { position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; padding:16px; background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,0.8),transparent); display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:2px; }
  .bar { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); width:3px; border-radius:2px; animation:equalize 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .bar:nth-child(1){height:12px;animation-delay:0s}.bar:nth-child(2){height:20px;animation-delay:0.1s}.bar:nth-child(3){height:8px;animation-delay:0.2s}.bar:nth-child(4){height:16px;animation-delay:0.15s}.bar:nth-child(5){height:24px;animation-delay:0.05s}.bar:nth-child(6){height:10px;animation-delay:0.25s}.bar:nth-child(7){height:18px;animation-delay:0.3s}.bar:nth-child(8){height:14px;animation-delay:0.1s}
  @keyframes equalize{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(0.3)}}
  .float-stat { position:absolute; background:rgba(8,15,32,0.92); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; padding:12px 16px; backdrop-filter:blur(20px); font-size:0.78rem; white-space:nowrap; box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
  .float-stat-num { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent3); }
  .float-stat-label { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.72rem; margin-top:2px; }
  .stat-top { top:-20px; right:40px; animation:floatY 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .stat-bottom { bottom:-20px; left:30px; animation:floatY 4s ease-in-out infinite 2s; }
  @keyframes floatY{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}

  /* SEARCH */
  .search-section { padding:0 48px 72px; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; width:100%; }
  .search-wrap { position:relative; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; }
  .search-input { width:100%; background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:17px 130px 17px 54px; font-size:1rem; color:var(--text); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; outline:none; transition:all 0.3s; font-weight:300; }
  .search-input:focus { border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.45); background:var(--bg2); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(37,99,235,0.1); }
  .search-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted); }
  .search-icon { position:absolute; left:18px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:var(--muted); }
  .search-btn-in { position:absolute; right:10px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); padding:8px 20px; font-size:0.875rem; }

  /* FEATURED */
  .featured-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr; min-height:360px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s; }
  .featured-card:hover { border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.35); box-shadow:0 32px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .featured-thumb { position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060c1a 0%,#0a1a3e 40%,#1a3a7a 70%,#2563eb 100%); }
  .featured-thumb-overlay { position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:background 0.3s; }
  .featured-card:hover .featured-thumb-overlay { background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
  .featured-big-play { width:78px; height:78px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(10px); transition:all 0.3s; }
  .featured-card:hover .featured-big-play { background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 40px var(--glow); }
  .featured-big-play svg { width:30px; height:30px; fill:white; margin-left:4px; }
  .featured-info { padding:36px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; }
  .featured-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:rgba(37,99,235,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.28); border-radius:100px; padding:4px 12px; font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--accent3); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; width:fit-content; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .featured-title { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.65rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1.15; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .featured-desc { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.65; margin-bottom:28px; font-weight:300; }
  .featured-author { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:0.85rem; }
  .feat-av { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#93c5fd); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:700; font-size:0.75rem; }
  .feat-name { font-weight:500; }
  .feat-subs { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.78rem; }
  .deco { position:absolute; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; }
  .deco1 { width:200px; height:200px; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(37,99,235,0.5),transparent 70%); top:-50px; left:-50px; }
  .deco2 { width:150px; height:150px; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(59,130,246,0.35),transparent 70%); bottom:-30px; right:80px; }

  /* VIDEO GRID */
  .video-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr)); gap:22px; }
  .video-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.3s,box-shadow 0.3s,border-color 0.3s; }
  .video-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
  .thumb { aspect-ratio:16/9; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .thumb-bg { width:100%; height:100%; transition:transform 0.4s ease; }
  .video-card:hover .thumb-bg { transform:scale(1.04); }
  .thumb-overlay { position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:background 0.3s; }
  .video-card:hover .thumb-overlay { background:rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
  .play-btn-mini { width:46px; height:46px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.95); border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; opacity:0; transform:scale(0.7); transition:opacity 0.3s,transform 0.3s; }
  .play-btn-mini svg { width:17px; height:17px; fill:var(--bg); margin-left:2px; }
  .video-card:hover .play-btn-mini { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
  .duration { position:absolute; bottom:8px; right:8px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8); border-radius:6px; padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.04em; }
  .video-info { padding:14px 16px 16px; }
  .video-title { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:0.93rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.35; margin-bottom:8px; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; }
  .video-meta { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--muted); }
  .avatar { width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.65rem; font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0; color:white; }
  .meta-sep { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

  /* Thumb colors - blue theme */
  .t1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060c1a,#2563eb)}
  .t2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#06091a,#1d4ed8 60%,#4f46e5)}
  .t3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060c1a,#0369a1)}
  .t4{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#090618,#1d4ed8 60%,#7c3aed)}
  .t5{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060f1a,#0ea5e9)}
  .t6{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#06091a,#1e40af 60%,#3b82f6)}
  .t7{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#060c1f,#1d4ed8)}
  .t8{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#080618,#4f46e5)}
  .av1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#3b82f6)}
  .av2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#7c3aed)}
  .av3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9,#06b6d4)}
  .av4{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d4ed8,#0ea5e9)}
  .av5{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e40af,#3b82f6)}
  .av6{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4338ca,#6d28d9)}

  /* CATEGORIES */
  .cats { background:var(--bg2); border-top:1px solid var(--border); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
  .cat-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr)); gap:16px; }
  .cat-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; padding:20px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.25s; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .cat-card::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.3s; }
  .cat-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.3); }
  .cat-card:hover::before { opacity:1; }
  .cat-icon { font-size:1.8rem; margin-bottom:10px; display:block; }
  .cat-name { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .cat-count { font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--muted); }
  .cc1::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(37,99,235,0.12),transparent)}
  .cc2::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(79,70,229,0.12),transparent)}
  .cc3::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,165,233,0.12),transparent)}
  .cc4::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(29,78,216,0.12),transparent)}
  .cc5::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(59,130,246,0.12),transparent)}
  .cc6::before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(67,56,202,0.12),transparent)}

  /* STATS */
  .stats-band { background:var(--bg3); border-top:1px solid var(--border); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:48px; }
  .stats-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:40px; max-width:960px; margin:0 auto; text-align:center; }
  .stat-number { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:2.8rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.04em; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--text),var(--muted)); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; line-height:1; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .stat-label { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.875rem; }

  /* UPLOAD CTA */
  .upload-cta { background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(37,99,235,0.15) 0%,rgba(29,78,216,0.1) 50%,rgba(14,165,233,0.1) 100%); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius:24px; padding:64px; text-align:center; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .upload-cta::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 300px at 50% 50%,rgba(37,99,235,0.08),transparent); pointer-events:none; }
  .upload-cta h2 { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,3rem); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.04em; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .upload-cta p { color:var(--muted); max-width:480px; margin:0 auto 36px; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:300; line-height:1.6; }
  .cta-actions { display:flex; gap:14px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .upload-icon-big { width:80px; height:80px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:20px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin:0 auto 28px; font-size:2rem; }

  /* LIVE BADGE */
  .live-badge { background:#ef4444; color:white; font-size:0.65rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:4px; text-transform:uppercase; }
  .live-card { position:relative; }
  .live-indicator { position:absolute; top:10px; left:10px; z-index:2; }

  /* AUTH PAGES */
  .auth-page { min-height:100vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:100px 24px 40px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .auth-bg { position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(ellipse 800px 500px at 50% 40%,rgba(37,99,235,0.1),transparent); pointer-events:none; }
  .auth-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:24px; padding:48px; width:100%; max-width:440px; position:relative; z-index:2; box-shadow:0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
  .auth-logo { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:32px; font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
  .auth-logo img { width:34px; height:34px; object-fit:contain; image-rendering:pixelated; }
  .auth-title { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.8rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.03em; text-align:center; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .auth-sub { color:var(--muted); text-align:center; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:32px; font-weight:300; }
  .form-group { margin-bottom:18px; }
  .form-label { font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:8px; display:block; }
  .form-input { width:100%; background:var(--bg3); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:13px 16px; font-size:0.95rem; color:var(--text); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; outline:none; transition:all 0.2s; }
  .form-input:focus { border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.5); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.1); }
  .form-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted); font-weight:300; }
  .auth-btn { width:100%; padding:14px; margin-top:8px; font-size:1rem; border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .auth-divider { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin:20px 0; }
  .auth-divider::before,.auth-divider::after { content:""; flex:1; height:1px; background:var(--border); }
  .auth-divider span { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; }
  .auth-switch { text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:0.875rem; }
  .auth-switch a { color:var(--accent3); cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; }
  .auth-switch a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
  .forgot { text-align:right; margin-top:-10px; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .forgot a { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; cursor:pointer; transition:color 0.2s; }
  .forgot a:hover { color:var(--accent3); }

  /* UPLOAD PAGE */
  .upload-page { min-height:100vh; padding:120px 48px 60px; }
  .upload-zone { border:2px dashed rgba(37,99,235,0.35); border-radius:20px; padding:64px; text-align:center; background:rgba(37,99,235,0.04); transition:all 0.3s; cursor:pointer; }
  .upload-zone:hover { border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.7); background:rgba(37,99,235,0.08); }
  .upload-zone-icon { font-size:3.5rem; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .upload-zone h3 { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .upload-zone p { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:300; max-width:360px; margin:0 auto 28px; line-height:1.6; }
  .upload-form { max-width:680px; margin:40px auto 0; }
  .upload-form-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:32px; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .upload-form-card h4 { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:20px; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; font-size:0.8rem; }

  /* SUBSCRIPTIONS */
  .subs-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:20px; }
  .sub-card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:24px; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.25s; }
  .sub-card:hover { border-color:rgba(37,99,235,0.35); transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .sub-avatar { width:72px; height:72px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 auto 14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:800; color:white; }
  .sub-name { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px; }
  .sub-count { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.78rem; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .sub-btn { width:100%; padding:8px; font-size:0.8rem; border-radius:8px; }

  /* PAGE HEADER */
  .page-header { padding:120px 48px 48px; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; }
  .page-title { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:2.5rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.04em; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .page-sub { color:var(--muted); font-size:1rem; font-weight:300; }

  /* LIVE */
  .live-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr)); gap:24px; }
  .live-card-inner { background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.3s; }
  .live-card-inner:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-color:rgba(239,68,68,0.3); }
  .live-thumb { aspect-ratio:16/9; position:relative; }
  .live-thumb-bg { width:100%; height:100%; }
  .live-viewers { position:absolute; bottom:10px; left:10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75); border-radius:6px; padding:3px 10px; font-size:0.72rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; }
  .live-dot { width:6px; height:6px; background:#ef4444; border-radius:50%; animation:pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .live-info { padding:14px 16px 16px; }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer { background:var(--bg2); border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding:56px 48px 36px; }
  .footer-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:48px; margin-bottom:48px; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto 48px; }
  .footer-brand .logo { margin-bottom:14px; }
  .footer-desc { color:var(--muted); font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.7; max-width:240px; font-weight:300; }
  .footer-col h4 { font-family:"Syne",sans-serif; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:18px; }
  .footer-col ul { list-style:none; }
  .footer-col li { margin-bottom:10px; }
  .footer-col a { color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; font-size:0.875rem; transition:color 0.2s; font-weight:300; cursor:pointer; }
  .footer-col a:hover { color:var(--text); }
  .footer-bottom { border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding-top:28px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:0.8rem; max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; }

  /* Fade in */
  .fade-up { opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px); animation:fadeUp 0.6s ease forwards; }
  @keyframes fadeUp{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
  .d1{animation-delay:0.05s}.d2{animation-delay:0.15s}.d3{animation-delay:0.25s}.d4{animation-delay:0.35s}.d5{animation-delay:0.45s}

  @media(max-width:900px){
    nav{padding:0 20px}
    .nav-links{display:none}
    .hero,.section{padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}
    .hero-preview{display:none}
    .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
    .featured-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .featured-thumb{min-height:200px}
    .upload-cta,.upload-page{padding:40px 20px}
    .page-header{padding:100px 20px 32px}
    .auth-card{padding:32px 24px}
  }
</style>
</head>

<!-- ═══════════ PAGE: UPLOAD ═══════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-upload">
  <div class="upload-page">
    <div class="container" style="max-width:860px">
      <div style="margin-bottom:40px"><div class="page-title" style="padding:0;margin-bottom:8px">📹 Загрузить видео</div><div class="page-sub" style="padding:0">Поделись своим контентом с миллионами зрителей</div></div>

      <div class="upload-zone" onclick="this.style.borderColor='rgba(37,99,235,0.9)'">
        <div class="upload-zone-icon">☁️</div>
        <h3>Перетащи файл сюда</h3>
        <p>Поддерживаются форматы MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV. Максимальный размер — 10 ГБ</p>
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-large">Выбрать файл</button>
      </div>

      <div class="upload-form">
        <div class="upload-form-card">
          <h4>Основная информация</h4>
          <div class="form-group"><label class="form-label">Название видео</label><input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Дай своему видео запоминающееся название..."></div>
          <div class="form-group"><label class="form-label">Описание</label><textarea class="form-input" rows="4" placeholder="Расскажи зрителям о чём это видео..." style="resize:vertical"></textarea></div>
          <div class="form-group"><label class="form-label">Теги</label><input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="музыка, клип, premiere (через запятую)"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="upload-form-card">
          <h4>Настройки публикации</h4>
          <div class="form-group"><label class="form-label">Категория</label>
            <select class="form-input" style="cursor:pointer">
              <option>Выбрать категорию...</option><option>🎬 Кино</option><option>🎵 Музыка</option><option>🔬 Наука</option><option>⚽ Спорт</option><option>🎮 Игры</option><option>✈️ Путешествия</option><option>🍳 Кулинария</option><option>📱 Технологии</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group"><label class="form-label">Доступность</label>
            <select class="form-input" style="cursor:pointer">
              <option>🌐 Публичное</option><option>🔗 По ссылке</option><option>🔒 Приватное</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:14px">
          <button class="btn btn-primary btn-large" style="flex:1">🚀 Опубликовать</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-large">Сохранить черновик</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  function showPage(name) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
    document.getElementById("page-" + name).classList.add("active");
    document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a").forEach(a => a.classList.remove("active"));
    const navEl = document.getElementById("nav-" + name);
    if (navEl) navEl.classList.add("active");
    window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: "smooth"});
  }

  // Tags
  document.querySelectorAll(".tag").forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener("click", function() {
      const parent = this.closest(".tags-row");
      parent.querySelectorAll(".tag").forEach(t => t.classList.remove("active"));
      this.classList.add("active");
    });
  });

  // Stars
  const starsEl = document.getElementById("stars");
  if (starsEl) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const s = document.createElement("div");
      s.className = "star";
      s.style.cssText = `left:${Math.random()*100}%;top:${Math.random()*100}%;--d:${2+Math.random()*4}s;animation-delay:${Math.random()*4}s;width:${Math.random()>0.8?3:2}px;height:${Math.random()>0.8?3:2}px`;
      starsEl.appendChild(s);
    }
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
